claim_boundary: This contract fixes offline MWORKS scenario inputs, parameter semantics, metrics, and required binding behavior. The bound source passed static validation and native CheckModel on 2026-07-27. The current authorization is limited to Official PID native-continuous ClimbPath recovery and seven-scenario replay; it does not authorize other-controller replay, gain tuning, code generation, or Gazebo runtime claims.

sampling_fairness.candidate_formal_runners: Each candidate retains its declared controller-execution boundary. A 0.01 s result interval standardizes exported sample cadence and metric evaluation; it does not imply controller-update equivalence.
sampling_fairness.official_pid: The Official PID baseline retains its native continuous reference, measurement, and command loop. Interval = 0.01 only standardizes result sampling and metric cadence; it does not impose a discrete controller update boundary.

yaw_policy.reason: The current shared controller contract has no yaw-reference port and current adapters use fixed yaw. Figure-eight scoring therefore evaluates translational tracking only.
yaw_policy.change_rule: Tangential-heading tracking requires an explicit yaw-reference interface and adapter-wide revalidation; it is outside this contract.

runner_binding_policy.rule: Do not create 84 duplicated Modelica runner classes. Each run must bind one existing formal runner, one trajectory class, and named plant-injection parameters through a versioned experiment profile and record the profile hash.

plant_rules.wind: Pass force vector and time window from the experiment profile into Sunray150Assembly. Force is a world-frame external force in N, not a wind-speed surrogate.
plant_rules.parameter_mismatch: Apply mass_scale and inertia_scale only to the physical plant body/dynamics. Controllers retain the nominal 1.0 kg profile so the test remains a true plant-model mismatch.
plant_rules.motor_fault: Compute a time-varying effectiveness vector inside the plant/dynamics path. For the failed rotor, both thrust and reaction-moment effectiveness are 1.0 before fault_start_s and fault_rotor_effectiveness at and after fault_start_s. A static parameter vector does not satisfy this contract.

step_metric_contract.overshoot_percent: Compute per axis in the signed direction of its nonzero step, normalized by abs(step_amplitude_m).
step_metric_contract.settling_time_s: After t=15 s, first time at which both stepped axes enter and remain inside plus-or-minus 5 percent of their respective step amplitudes until t=45 s.
step_metric_contract.steady_state_error_m: Mean Euclidean position error over t=40-45 s.

plant_injection.semantic: Persistent lateral 0.25 N force; not a wind-speed input.
Plant mass and principal inertia are increased by 20 percent while controller nominal parameters remain unchanged.
Only rotor 1 changes from 1.0 to 0.5 at t=15 s; it is not degraded from t=0.

required: CheckModel passes for bound runner and trajectory
maximum position_error_norm is less than 5.0 m
raw CSV, metrics, native result-window capture, profile hash, and plant/harness hashes are recorded
run_validity_gate.claim_boundary: This is a minimum numerical-closure gate. Scenario metrics are reported quantitatively and must not be relabeled as a performance pass solely because this gate passes.

metrics_implementation.owner: Scripts/results/calc_metrics.jl and a comparison script in the same directory
required_extensions: step settling time with persistent 5 percent band
metrics_implementation.syslab_requirement: The final comparison script must execute in MWORKS.Syslab/Julia and retain its command, input CSV hashes, output table, and figures with the run evidence.

matrix_policy.family_selection: This contract does not select winners. g6_champion_selection.json currently declares seven semantic families; the six currently adapted FormalRunner candidates are provisional and cannot be presented as a completed all-family ranking.
matrix_policy.core_ab_matrix: Official PID plus only measured family winners that pass current-source minimum closure.
matrix_policy.fixed_integrated_profiles: Optional engineering comparison rows. They do not replace a family winner and are not double-counted in family ranking.
matrix_policy.px4ctrl: Excluded until a behavior- and interface-equivalent MWORKS core passes its explicit equivalence gate.
